installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

mkdir -p /mnt/server/webroot/public
mkdir -p /mnt/server/tmp /mnt/server/logs

echo "Install complete. Runtime image entrypoint will seed start.sh (always) and seed nginx/php-fpm only if missing."

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description:
The command to startup the egg 
(Do not change if you do not know what you are doing!)

variables.name: Run composer install on startup
variables.description:
Runs `composer install` at startup if vendor/autoload.php is missing.

0 = false
1 = true

variables.name: Composer install flags
variables.description: Flags passed to `composer install` when RUN_COMPOSER_INSTALL is enabled.

variables.name: Composer modules
variables.description: Legacy field from the upstream egg. (Not used by startup anymore unless you wire it into start.sh.)

variables.name: Git Repo Address
variables.description:
Git repo to clone

I.E. https://github.com/finnie2006/repo_name

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description:
What branch to pull from github.

Default is blank to pull the repo default branch

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Pull the latest files on startup when using a GitHub repo.

variables.name: User Uploaded Files
variables.description:
Skip all the install stuff if you are letting a user upload files.

0 = false (default)
1 = true

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description:
Password to use with git.

It's best practice to use a Personal Access Token.
https://github.com/settings/tokens
https://gitlab.com/-/profile/personal_access_tokens

variables.name: Run on Start
variables.description:
Custom command to run during startup after code is pulled and before nginx starts. Can be multiple commands separated by ; or newlines

EX: php artisan config:clear;php artisan route:clear;php artisan optimize:clear;php artisan route:list
like custom artisan commands etc.
variables.default_value: php artisan config:clear;php artisan route:clear;php artisan optimize:clear;php artisan route:list

variables.name: Init Laravel Project
variables.description: Scaffold laravel/laravel only when webroot is empty. Use 0 for git/zip/manual deploys.
